content.short: Felix is a borrowing and savings protocol on Hyperliquid built around its own stablecoin.
content.description: Felix lets users borrow against collateral on Hyperliquid and hold the proceeds as a stablecoin, with vaults that put idle balances to work. It is one of the larger protocols by value locked on the chain. A native stablecoin issued against local collateral reduces a chain's dependence on bridged dollars, which is usually the single largest counterparty exposure a young chain carries.
